caveats: One shared 4-vCPU Debian 13 VPS, 7.8 GiB RAM, no swap, warm page cache; one campaign.
wg up builds the semantic index too. Startup time and RSS include the semantic route.
The concurrency mix is fixed: absent, rare, common and broad regex; two reps of clients x 4 queries.
RSS is daemon VmRSS/Pss; text-index resident bytes are only the touched pages of the mapping.
Output parity uses --sort path exact bytes; unsorted ripgrep traversal order is not stable.
The Linux tree check used --model code and ran alone on the VPS.
